purpose: Machine-readable navigation, ownership, history-universe and proof-routing contract for agents working on Mithril-Wrapper.

layers.name: acceptance
layers.question: What observable Minecraft behavior must be preserved?

layers.name: host_api_contract
layers.question: What EGL/GL/LWJGL behavior is visible at the host boundary?

layers.name: gl_semantics
layers.question: What API state/object/error semantics exist independent of a native backend?

layers.name: backend_neutral_lowering
layers.question: What explicit immutable/native-ready contract is passed to execution backends?

layers.name: native_execution
layers.question: How is the lowered contract executed efficiently and safely?

layers.name: platform_presentation
layers.question: How does native GPU work reach the real Apple host and display?

layers.name: evidence
layers.question: Which oracle and environment falsify or prove each contract?

layers.name: convergence
layers.question: Which exact implementation and evidence may be treated as current?

components.summary: EGL exports, host negotiation, context/surface lifecycle and swap entry.
GLSL to SPIR-V translation, reflection and shared shader/resource ABI.
Backend-neutral resolved draw/resource/FBO contract and backend selection.
Metal-specific resource, pipeline and command execution below resolved semantics.
Vulkan/MoltenVK reference/fallback execution below resolved semantics.
CAMetalLayer/default-framebuffer origin/format and physical host presentation seam.
Focused semantic/readback/runtime oracles and cross-platform CTest registration.
Agent routing, branch audit, CI/evidence policy and machine-checkable repository control.
Disconnected legacy implementation, patch/replay and migration evidence sources.

boundaries.contract: host aliases/lifecycle may adapt negotiation but must not silently redefine LWJGL-visible GL semantics
mutable observable GL/shader state is resolved into explicit snapshots at the operation that observes it
DirectMetal executes resolved intent and does not invent backend-local GL policy
DirectVulkan executes resolved intent and does not invent backend-local GL policy
internal storage/origin semantics stay stable; platform origin/format conversion occurs only at an explicit presentation seam
runtime evidence is bound to exact semantic and source/tree/binary identity, not logs or native addresses alone
disconnected legacy history contributes focused invariants/oracles through explicit semantic transplant; it is not wholesale-promoted

proof_profiles.command: run the nearest focused smoke/oracle for the changed contract
proof_profiles.proves: the changed semantic invariant in isolation
hosted Metal runtime behavior, not physical-device equivalence

proof_profiles.command: run canonical Minecraft 26.2 client/E2E oracle against an exact product subject
proof_profiles.proves: real client integration for the selected scenario
physical presentation/platform behavior not established by hosted CI

proof_profiles.command: run correctness-gated fixed-workload interleaved baseline/candidate measurement
proof_profiles.proves: performance change under a stable matched workload

invariants: Observable GL/EGL semantics are owned above native backend execution whenever possible.
The DirectMetal shipping target must not contain or link Vulkan or MoltenVK implementation dependencies.
Queued native work must not depend on mutable frontend state after its lowering contract has been captured.
Legacy disconnected histories are sources of semantics, tests and evidence; they are not wholesale merge targets for the clean tree.
A capability claim is bound to an exact implementation SHA/tree and its actual oracle/environment evidence.
Branch dates and branch names never establish semantic containment.
Squash-merged work requires PR/tree comparison in addition to ancestry checks.
Temporary experiments should converge into a stable contract, regression or evidence plane before their branch is retired.
Pull-request candidate-head proof and synthetic merge-result proof are distinct subjects and must not be conflated.

evidence_planes.role: required main/PR build, semantic, merge-result integration and boundary gate
manual Apple runtime evidence not duplicated by normal build

agent_tools.role: compile exact Git identity, task/diff ownership, history-universe warnings, boundary risk and minimum proof/read set
emit live remote branch heads, history-universe/nearest-anchor topology, duplicate heads/trees and lineage coverage
agent_tools.deep_mode: --fetch-graph performs a blob-filtered remote-tracking ref refresh

agent_tools.role: materialize local Minecraft 26.2 reference sources for host/client behavior analysis
validate the machine-readable agent navigation, ownership, history-universe and proof contract
